description:
This is sheet 12 of 47 (dwg 196D5023, CAGE 89954, BAE Systems Controls, Endicott NY) showing two nearly identical harness/connector wiring blocks labeled BEL1-S (upper) and BEL2-S (lower), each terminating a multi-conductor cable to a device group consisting of a "BEL" connector (with pin RTN1), a "SYNC" twisted-pair connector, and a "CAN-A" connector (Shield/HI/LO). These appear to be sensor/actuator chain segments (BEL = possibly "Bell" or beacon/sensor chain unit) with CAN bus daisy-chain wiring and a sync signal, likely part of a sensor chain (S3 and S4 chain segments) rather than a powered load with breakers/fuses — no protective devices (breakers/fuses) are shown on this sheet; wiring originates from terminal strip BEL1-S / BEL2-S with numbered pin call-outs.

Top block (BEL1-S, associated with chain segment "S3"):
- Terminal strip "BEL1-S" (I/O row) with pins 2,7,11,3,1,8,9,5,6,N/C,10,4 each labeled with a net name:
  - Pin 2: G3-S3S1 FREQ_SELECT
  - Pin 7: G3-S3R1 VBATTERY RTN
  - Pin 11: G3-S321 CHAIN_OUTPUT
  - Pin 3: G3-S3S2 SYNC
  - Pin 1: G3-S329 ENABLE (N/C)
  - Pin 8: G3-S300a ADR_0 (N/C)
  - Pin 9: G3-S300b ADR_1 (N/C)
  - Pin 5: G3-S3AH CANA_HI
  - Pin 6: G3-S3AL CANA_LO
  - N/C pin: G3-S3AS CANA_Shield
  - Pin 10: G3-S3S3 CHAIN_SUPPLY
  - Pin 4: (feeds SYNC connector pin 3)
- Wires cross (twisted-pair crossing shown by X symbols) and route up to:
  - "BEL" connector block, pin RTN1 (fed by G3-S3R1 VBATTERY RTN, net also labeled G3-S3R1 SYNC_RTN near SYNC connector)
  - "SYNC" connector block with pins 10 and 3
  - "CAN-A" connector block with Shield, HI, LO pins (fed by G3-S3AH/G3-S3AL/G3-S3AS nets); a dashed oval indicates a splice/twist point or shield drain termination on the CANA_Shield line and on the CAN-A LO line run.

Bottom block (BEL2-S, associated with chain segment "S4"), mirrors the top block:
- Terminal strip "BEL2-S" (I/O row) with pins 2,7,11,3,1,8,9,5,6,N/C,10,4 each labeled:
  - Pin 2: G3-S4S1 FREQ_SELECT
  - Pin 7: G3-S4R1 VBATTERY RTN
  - Pin 11: G3-S421 CHAIN_OUTPUT
  - Pin 3: G3-S4S2 SYNC
  - Pin 1: G3-S429 ENABLE (N/C)
  - Pin 8: G3-S400a ADR_0 (N/C)
  - Pin 9: G3-S400b ADR_1 (N/C)
  - Pin 5: G3-S4AH CANA_HI
  - Pin 6: G3-S4AL CANA_LO
  - N/C pin: G3-S4AS CANA_Shield
  - Pin 10: G3-S4S3 CHAIN_SUPPLY
  - Pin 4: SYNC pin 4
- Routes to a second "BEL" connector (RTN1, fed by G3-S4R1 VBATTERY RTN / G3-S4R1 SYNC_RTN), a second "SYNC" connector (pins 9 and 4), and a second "CAN-A" connector (Shield/HI/LO) with a similar dashed-oval splice indicator on shield/LO lines.

No protective devices (fuses/breakers) or control switches/relays/PLC outputs are depicted on this sheet; it is purely a point-to-point wiring/pinout diagram for two chain segments (S3, S4) of what is likely a CAN-bus sensor daisy-chain assembly with battery return, sync, address, enable and chain-supply/chain-output signals. No cross-reference call-outs to other drawings/sheets are printed on this sheet body (title block references "SEE TITLE PAGE" for export-control warning and revision block shows no entries).
